title: Platform Evidence Cards — Sellproof (WIP)
summary: Working sketch of short, evidence-focused cards for sellers to surface technical SLOs, economic delta, and demo cues tailored to platform teams. Designed to be used live (30-90s) during discovery and to live in a one-page repo for AEs and SEs.
purpose: Reduce friction in technical discovery by giving sellers 3–4 evidence bites per persona: what to show, what metric moves, a 1-liner demo cue, and a quick answer to the most probable pushback. Aim: shorten pilot qualification time and improve conversion to Reserved/Dedicated deals.
audience_personas: Infra/Capacity Lead (throughput, autoscaling, cost per token)
Security/Compliance contact (data isolation, KMS, audit logs)
card_template_fields: Next-step ask (pilot artifact or data we need)
example_card_platform_architect: Thesis: They care about predictable latency and graceful degradation across tenants.
Key proof point: 95th percentile latency under multimodal load — show sample console trace where P95=120ms at 80% capacity (source: dedi-customer-sim run ID 2025-07-21).
Demo cue: Open Console -> Route Policy -> Show canary fallback to cheaper quantized model and the instant change in latency/cost visualization.

Talk track: 'We route by latency policy so you get consistent tail latency. If a spike threatens SLOs we can fail over to an economically compatible variant with automated fallback — keeps the app live, no config change required.'
ROI anchor: Reduces incident-led downtime by estimated 3–6 hrs/month for 500qps workloads (customer case: fintech beta saved ~4.2hrs/month).
Next-step ask: Request 5 representative API traces and a small prompt set (5–10) for variant-quality check.
example_card_infra_lead: Thesis: Throughput and unit economics matter first; opaque token cost leads to overprovisioning.
Key proof point: Cost per 1M tokens for 2048-length bursts with batching vs naive config — show our Optimize recommendation snapshot with predicted 35% cost reduction.
Demo cue: Show Optimize -> batching suggestion -> simulate savings with their qps profile (2 slider moves).

Talk track: 'We measure your workload shape and produce concrete batching + quantization profiles that lower cost while maintaining latency SLOs. You can preview simulated unit economics before applying.'
ROI anchor: For customers with steady daytime peaks, we see 20–40% lower per-token cost in their first month after applying recommendations.
Next-step ask: Share a week of qps-by-latency histograms (or grant read-only CloudWatch/GCP logging access) to produce a custom Optimize simulation.
example_card_product_ai_engineer: Thesis: Model quality and reproducibility are #1; they want quick regression checks tied to code rollouts.
Key proof point: Show an eval run where a model rollout triggered quality regression alerts on our eval-set (screenshot + time series).
Demo cue: Open Eval -> show failing prompts -> show automatic rollback policy configured for semantic regression thresholds.
Talk track: 'Every rollout can be tied to a prompt set. If quality dips below your cutoff we automatically rollback and notify the team; you control the threshold.'
ROI anchor: Fewer customer-facing regressions -> lower incident/rollback costs; example: edtech customer cut post-release regressions by ~60% in month one.
Next-step ask: Provide a 20–50 prompt seed list and permission to run a single eval against the candidate model.
demo_playbook_quick_script: Opening (15s): 'Quickly show a single route performance view and one fallback in action — goal is to build trust in predictable behavior.'
Latency demo (45s): 'Console -> Route -> Show P95 timeline -> Trigger spike via replay -> show automatic fallback and latency graph recovering.'
Cost demo (40s): 'Optimize -> Apply suggested batching -> Show simulated monthly savings slide for customer profile.'
Eval demo (60s): 'Eval -> Select prompt set -> Show baseline vs candidate -> Flip rollback toggle to demonstrate protective guardrails.'
top_10_objections_and_short_replies: 'We already built this in-house' -> 'Great — what if we run a 2-week head-to-head on identical workloads? Our goal is to show operational delta and cost leakage you might be missing.'
'Vendor lock / custom infra' -> 'We support hybrid: same API and routing, optional private control plane, and an on-prem package for air-gapped environments.'
'Price' -> 'We can model expected unit costs for 90-day pilot and offer cost-neutral proof-of-value for qualifying trials.'
'SLA skepticism' -> 'We provide SLA commitments for Dedicated and audit logs + KMS integrations for Private customers.'
'Data residency' -> 'Private deployments and VPC options with customer-managed KMS and audit trail.'
'Model quality tradeoff with quantization' -> 'We pre-evaluate candidates on your prompt set and expose per-prompt deltas before applying.'
'Integration time' -> 'Javascript/Python SDKs + same REST contract. Typical POC integration ~2 days for product teams.'
'Scaling to millions of users' -> 'Customers run Reserved/Dedicated clusters with autoscaling policies and predictable throughput.'
'Canary complexity' -> 'Console provides visual canary composer and one-click rollback; templates for common canary plans.'
'Audit and compliance for regulated verticals' -> 'Private + support for HSM/KMS, retention controls, and enterprise audit exports.'
seller_handoff_checklist_for_pilot: Business objective (one-liner): what the pilot must prove in plain language
Primary persona and stakeholders with emails
Representative prompt set (5–50 prompts) and 1 week of traffic traces
Access required (read-only logs or temporary API key), security requirements
Definition of success (SLOs + ROI threshold + timeline)
Risk mitigations (rollback plan, fallback policy, data handling)
metrics_considered: tokens per minute and tokens per request distribution
cost per 1M tokens under current vs optimized config
quality delta on evaluation prompt set (BLEU/ROUGE/semantic scoring)
open_questions_we_need_from_product: Can we add a pre-built sales demo environment for SRE-style demos (isolated tenant with synthetic load)?
What's the telemetry retention policy we can promise to prospects for pilot logs?
Any plan to auto-generate per-customer Optimize simulations from uploaded traces?
notes: This is intentionally terse. Goal is to iterate into a set of 6–8 one-pagers that live in Confluence + a small deck for AE/SE quick reference. Next steps: 1) validate metrics and exemplar screenshots with Observability team, 2) record 3 short demo videos (30–90s) for each persona, 3) run internal role-play with SEs, 4) add final micro-graphics for console flows.
